summary.text: Meg Luger-Nikolai is a Democratic member of the Minnesota House of Representatives for District 64A who took office on February 3, 2026, after winning a special election, and is seeking a full term on November 3, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Meg Luger-Nikolai earned a bachelor's degree in English, a law degree, and a master's degree in public policy from the University of Minnesota, and her career experience includes working as an attorney.

Ballotpedia lists her affiliations as the College of Labor and Employment Lawyers, the Minnesota Public Employment Relations Board, the labor and employment law section of the Minnesota State Bar Association, the Minnesota Urban Debate League, and the board of Central Minnesota Legal Services.
Luger-Nikolai defeated Republican Dan Walsh in the January 27, 2026 special general election for District 64A.
No Republican candidate is listed for the November 3, 2026 general election for the seat.
